2116827800380616900.en_summary: Justin Sun says transparency is one of TRON’s strengths, quoting BitcoinNews that open blockchains give law enforcement more ways to trace illicit funds, citing T3 FCU’s work freezing ~$300M over 3 years.
2116827800380616900.zh_summary: Justin Sun表示透明度是TRON的優勢之一，引用BitcoinNews指開放區塊鏈為執法提供更多追查非法資金的途徑，並提及T3 FCU三年內凍結約3億美元的工作。

2116824922228207941.en_summary: (Reposted by @cz_binance) Kevin Follonier says Binance withdrawals are working again, haters and bears in disbelief, wall of worry, this market is bullish and going much higher.
2116824922228207941.zh_summary: （由@cz_binance轉帖）Kevin Follonier表示幣安提款已重新運作，唱空者和空頭完全不敢相信，擔憂之牆，這個市場非常看漲，將會走得更高。

2116848191023014389.en_summary: Robin Brooks explains Italy's TARGET2 liability is the counterpart to cumulative ECB buying of Italian gov't debt. Private capital flows to Italy collapsed from 2010, replaced by official ECB QE flows. TARGET2 is debt Italy owes.
2116848191023014389.zh_summary: Robin Brooks解釋意大利的TARGET2負債是歐央行累計購買意大利政府債務的對應項。自2010年起私人資本流向意大利崩潰，被官方歐央行QE流動取代。TARGET2就是意大利欠下的債務。

2116846273575657650.en_summary: Robin Brooks did a Sunday live stream on possible further downside for gold and silver if returning to a "hot" war. A 10% rise in Brent maps into a 4% drop for gold and 8% fall for silver.
2116846273575657650.zh_summary: Robin Brooks進行週日直播，討論如果重新進入「熱」戰爭，黃金和白銀可能進一步下行。布蘭特原油上漲10%對應黃金下跌4%、白銀下跌8%。
